text: In 1971, the girl Lucie escapes a slaughterhouse where she was [held and tortured for over a year|wrong|harm done to children], and in an orphanage finds a friend in Anna. Fifteen years later Lucie bursts into the home of the ordinary-seeming Belfond family with a shotgun, sure they were her captors, while [a disfigured woman only she can see|rules|only some can see it] keeps cutting her. Anna comes to help clean up, and beneath the house [finds a hidden passage|images|the house and its rooms] that leads toward [a secret society chasing the afterlife through pain|origin|secret worshippers among us].
